title: Should You Have THIS In Your LinkedIn Headline? ✍️
description:
Lots of people put "Ex-[COMPANY]" in their headline—but should you?

Some would argue yes, that your headline is what gets people to click—the trailer for your profile.

But would you start a first date by talking about your ex?

Maybe you worked for a big-name company—that's awesome. But that's what your "Experience" section is for. Or your "About" section.

Your LinkedIn headline only has 220 characters, so those are better spent showing your value and keywords, not summarizing the places you've worked.
